Old School RuneScape

Farm Run Planner

Choose what you're growing and how you like to travel. You get the quickest order for your patches, plus the teleports and supplies to bring.

How it works

Every patch, teleport landing, spirit tree and fairy ring is a point on a map of connections, and every teleport, walk or hop has a time. Walking times come from the game's real collision map, so they go around walls and water instead of cutting straight across. For your settings, the planner finds the quickest way to each patch and the best order to visit them.

Getting around

Where the run begins and how you like to travel.

Casting, clicking and loading. Raise it if you would rather walk short distances.

Fine-tune

Optional. The defaults suit most players.

Transport you can use

Untick anything you don't own or don't want the route to use.

Networks unlocked

Spirit trees, mushtrees and quetzals unlock one stop at a time — tick only the ones you have.

Quests and diaries you've finished

Some teleports and patches only unlock after these. Tick what you've done.

Patches to include

Untick a patch to leave it out. Greyed patches are locked by your levels or quests.

Advanced

Switch off a single place or connection to stop the planner using it, for example a teleport you don't like. These choices win over the setup panel: a route never uses anything unticked here, even if its transport is allowed.

Every place and how they connect, drawn as a web. Big dots are patches, a ring marks a stop on your route, and lines are teleports, walks and hops. Click a dot to see only its connections, or drag it to rearrange.
